findings.detail: The phase contract requires the `stopGate` and `reviewBudget.onSoftLimit` rows to be checked against their source defaults as well as their enum choices, but this test only checks enum membership. If the source default changes from `req` to `phase` or from `ask` to `auto` while the enum stays unchanged, normal setup uses the new default while both quick-start documents continue to advertise the old one, and this suite remains green because every enum value still occurs in the row. Derive the actual defaults from `buildQuestions({})` (or `DEFAULTS`) and assert the Default-column value for both rows.

next_action: Add source-to-document default assertions for the two setup rows, then rerun the phase contract suite.

observations.detail: `npm run typecheck` passed. Vitest and docs lint could not run in this sandbox because child-process spawning fails with `EPERM`; this is an environment limitation.

Outside the staged diff, configuration docs and setup option notes still use fixed 6–8-round wording despite invalid responses changing the call number. Track that documentation/UI cleanup separately.
